questions.prompt: Which schedule matches the labeled Ibrance starting dose?
options: 125 mg daily for 21 days, then 7 days off
100 mg for 14 days, then 14 days off
questions.rationale: The recommended starting dose is 125 mg once daily on Days 1–21 of each 28-day cycle.

questions.prompt: Which kinases are directly inhibited by palbociclib?
questions.rationale: The prescribing information identifies palbociclib as an inhibitor of CDK4 and CDK6.

questions.prompt: During the first two cycles, when does the label specifically add a CBC check beyond cycle start?
questions.rationale: CBC monitoring is specified on Day 15 of the first two cycles in addition to baseline and cycle-start checks.

questions.prompt: What investigator-assessed median PFS values were reported in the PALOMA-2 label table?
questions.rationale: PALOMA-2 reported median PFS of 24.8 months for Ibrance plus letrozole and 14.5 months for placebo plus letrozole.
